subject: general
question:
In the given letter-cluster triads, the letter-clusters in a particular triad are related following a certain logic. Study the given triads carefully and from the given options, select the triad that follows the same logic.

ABC : DFH : ILO

RST : UWY : ZCF
solution:
According to the English alphabets & their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 

The pattern followed in the given clusters is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f37b07dd766733bd3deded78396e1b65defb927f0a519b1d91d7f5b9f6e888ad.png] 

and

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ee4cb6f3fc06bce5db20754ca1a02e42979de4878b9246d30360b756f2591ec.png] 

From the given options **only FGH : IKM : NQT follows the same pattern,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a579a5687a76aae92edfabe8eeccffc9e6af0b8f2dca27f1b966e35df48e299.png] 

Hence the correct answer is **option 3)**
